name: core chemotaxis signalling pathway
description: Receptor, kinase core, response regulator and adaptation, with signal termination accessory.

name: aspartate chemoreception pathway
description: The Tar receptor feeding the shared chemotaxis kinase, response and adaptation functions. The three downstream functions are the same curated rows the core pathway uses, not copies of them.

name: PhoR/PhoB phosphate regulon
description: The enterobacterial and pseudomonad form of the phosphate starvation two-component system.

name: PhoR/PhoP phosphate regulon
description: The Bacillus-type form, sharing the sensor with the PhoR/PhoB circuit and differing in the cognate response regulator.
